title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
abstract: arXiv:2608.17744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reasoning traces, even when the question is Greek, so the model answers correctly while reasoning in a form its user cannot read, audit, or correct. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), every released checkpoint reasons in the language of the question on ~98% of items, one family at 3x fewer tokens, with judged grammaticality improving on all four models and general ability within a few points of each base: nothing was forgotten, and fluency was gained

translated_title: 用低资源语言思考：监督微调构建了什么，强化学习修复了什么，准确率无法揭示什么
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17744v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：选取三个前沿的混合专家模型（阿里巴巴、OpenAI、英伟达；每个模型约3.6-4.0B激活参数），并对其进行微调，使其能够用低资源语言进行推理。在准确率基准测试上，几乎没有任何变化，而在这个规模下，基准测试本身充满噪声：仅改变随机种子就能使分数波动7.7个百分点，这比我们测量的所有数据和配方效应都大。这个零结果是我们的第一个发现。真正的变化发生在准确率无法捕捉的地方。基础模型从未用希腊语思考：在1000个推理轨迹中，即使问题是希腊语，也有0个轨迹用希腊语，因此模型虽然回答正确，但推理形式是用户无法阅读、审计或纠正的。经过监督微调（SFT）后，所有发布的检查点在约98%的项目上用问题语言进行推理，一个系列使用了3倍更少的令牌，所有四个模型的语法判断质量均有所提升，而通用能力与每个基础模型相差无几：没有遗忘任何内容，且获得了流利度。
tldr: 该论文发现，在低资源语言推理中，准确率基准无法捕捉关键变化，而监督微调能促使模型用目标语言推理并提升语法能力，同时不损失通用能力。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that accuracy benchmarks fail to capture key changes in low-resource language reasoning, while supervised fine-tuning enables models to reason in the target language and improves grammaticality without sacrificing general ability.
